byte_order.docs:
The byte order of the display buffer. Options are `big_endian` and `little_endian` (default). This affects the byte order for the buffer when using 16 bit color depth. The default is appropriate for the majority of displays.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

color_depth.docs:
The color depth of the display buffer, expressed in bits. Options are `16` (default) and `24`. Preferably should be the same as the `pixel_mode` option.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

color_order.docs:
Should be one of `bgr` (default) or `rgb`. This specifies the order of the color channels in the display panel. The default is `bgr` for most displays, but some displays may require `rgb`. It does not affect the color order of the display buffer, which is always RGB.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

height.docs:
**int**: Specifies height of display in pixels.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

offset_height.docs:
**int**: Specify an offset for the y-direction of the display. Default is 0.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

offset_width.docs:
**int**: Specify an offset for the x-direction of the display, typically used when an LCD is smaller than the maximum supported by the driver chip. Default is 0

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

width.docs:
**int**: Specifies width of display.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

dimensions.docs:
Dimensions of the screen, specified either as *width* **x** *height* (e.g `320x240`  ) or with separate config keys. If not provided the dimensions will be determined by the model selected. This is required for the `CUSTOM` model, and is optional for other models. The dimensions are specified in pixels, and the width and height must be greater than 0. The following keys are available:

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

draw_rounding.docs:
The rounding factor for drawing operations. Defaults to 2. Some chips require a higher value to avoid display artifacts. Must be a power of 2.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

enable_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: An optional pin to enable the display, if required. A list of pins can be provided for displays that require multiple enable pins. A full pin configuration may be provided to set the pin mode and inverted property. By default the pin will be driven high to enable the display.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

hsync_back_porch.docs:
**int**: The horizontal back porch length.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

hsync_front_porch.docs:
**int**: The horizontal front porch length.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

hsync_pulse_width.docs:
**int**: The horizontal sync pulse width.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

init_sequence.docs:
Allows custom initialisation sequences to be added. See below for more information.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

invert_colors.docs:
**boolean**: Specifies whether the display colors should be inverted. Options are `true` or `false`. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

lane_bit_rate.docs:
**int**: The bit rate of the serial data lanes. No default unless a non-custom model is selected.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

lanes.docs:
**int**: Number of serial data lanes to use - 1 or 2. Default is 2.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

model.docs:
Chosen from the lists of supported chips and models above, or `CUSTOM` for custom displays.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

pclk_frequency.docs:
Set the pixel clock speed. Default is 40MHz.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

pixel_mode.docs:
Select the interface mode for the display driver. Options are `16bit` (default) and `24bit`.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

reset_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The RESET pin, if required.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

transform.docs:
If `rotation` is not sufficient, use this to transform the display. If this option is specified, then the `dimensions` option must also be provided. The value can either be the string `disabled` to disable hardware transform, or a dictionary. For the `CUSTOM` model, use `transform: disabled` if the display does not support it, which will prevent a `rotation` being translated to a hardware transform, otherwise the options below. Note that DSI displays do not support axis swapping so only mirroring of x and y axes is possible, and rotations by 90 or 270 must be handled by software.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

use_axis_flips.docs:
If true, the driver will use alternate bits in the MADCTL register to implement x and y mirroring. Defaults to false.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

vsync_back_porch.docs:
**int**: The vertical back porch length.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

vsync_front_porch.docs:
**int**: The vertical front porch length.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

vsync_pulse_width.docs:
**int**: The vertical sync pulse width.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*

rotation.docs:
Rotate the display presentation in software. Choose one of `0°`, `90°`, `180°`, or `270°`. If the driver chip supports hardware rotation for the given orientation this will be translated to the appropriate hardware command. If hardware rotation is not supported, the display will be rotated in software.

*See also: [MIPI DSI Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_dsi#configuration-options)*
